title: Montana's Award-Winning Breweries Ranked: Who Comes Out on Top? - NewsBreak
text:
By Chris Wolfe ,
7 hours ago
You can follow Montana’s changing of the seasons just by walking down the beer aisle in your local grocery store.
Is autumn on the way? Don’t forget your Oktoberfest or pumpkin brews. Is summer around the corner? Don’t forget to pick up some of your favorite honey beer or summer brews.
Montana’s Seasonal Beer Culture There has been some big news in the beer world lately. Michelob Ultra has become the top-selling beer brand in the country, according to Fox Business News.
READ MORE: How Montana’s Beer Scene Balances Local Craft Brews And National Icons
Montana’s brewers work hard to create high-quality beer. We know this because there have been some amazing award-winning beers, not just in Montana, there have been brews that have been recognized on a global stage.
READ MORE: Drink Up! Several Montana Breweries Recognized Internationally At Beer & Cider Awards
Beer drinking in Montana isn’t going away any time soon. As a matter of fact, both the University of Montana and Montana State University offer classes on brewing beer.
Stacker has compiled a list of the Montana breweries with the most highly ranked beers in the top 100 according to data from Beer Advocate .
via GIPHY
Out of all the breweries on the list, there is one that stands out among the others, by a lot.
Beer Advocate’s Top Montana Breweries The brewery with the highest number of ranked beers is Mountains Walking Brewery out of Bozeman. They have 21 ranked beers, three times as many as the second-highest rated brewery.
Download the KZOQ-FM Mobile App Now I have sampled beers from many of the breweries on the list. There is a reason why so many breweries in Montana are getting high rankings; the brewers in Montana care about their craft, and it shows. Please enjoy responsibly and check out the breweries with the most ranked beers in Montana.
Click here to view photo gallery
The Five Most Iconic Beers In Montana These beers from Montana are homegrown and beloved by locals. Gallery Credit: Will Gordon Kettlehouse Brewing Company via Instagram Cold Smoke from Kettlehouse Brewing Company Cold Smoke is Montana's most famous and beloved beer. You can find this beer in virtually every bar, restaurant, and store across Montana. There demand for Cold Smoke is always high. They've had shortages in the past. It has to be one of the best. Madison River Brewing Company via Facebook Salmon Fly Honey Rye from Madison River Brewing Company One of the few Montana beers distributed in bottles, Salmon Fly can be found in restaurants, bars, and stores across Montana. It's a local favorite. Big Sky Brewing Company via Facebook Moose Drool from Big Sky Brewing Company This Missoula beer was the first beer to put Montana on the map for craft beer. This brown ale has been one of Montana's most circulated beers statewide and nationally for years. Lewis and Clark Brewing Company via Facebook Miner's Gold from Lewis and Clark Brewing Company This Helena brewery is an iconic brewery in Montana and their Hefeweizen is one of their best. Miner's Gold is Big Sky Country's best hefeweizen. Philipsburg Brewing Company via Facebook Otter Water from Philipsburg Brewing Company Philipsburg Brewing Company in the small town of Philipsburg makes some incredible beers. Otter Water is widely known across the state and a perfect beer for a laid back day.
